newsitem.title: GERMANY: German "wise man" sees dollar gains leveling off.
newsitem.headline: German "wise man" sees dollar gains leveling off.

text.p: Rolf Peffekoven, a member of Germany's council of independent economic advisors, or "five wise men," said on Thursday he did not expect the surging dollar to continue its rapid advance against the mark.
Speaking on Saarland Radio, Peffekoven added, however, he saw a break in the upward climb in the German stock market.
"I believe the dollar will not climb any higher than it is now," Peffekoven said, adding that Group of Seven (G7) nations could intervene to halt the dollar's advance.
Speaking about the German stock market, which like its U.S. counterpart, has hit repeated record highs, Peffekoven said the rally could run out of steam as soon as in the next few days.
He also said he doubted that the Bundesbank would raise interest rates anytime soon.
